name: cheerwin-portfolio
description: Cheerwin Chandra's portfolio with a secure contact inbox and privacy compliance, ready for GitHub + Vercel + Neon Postgres.

scripts.prebuild:
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const m=['api/router.js','lib/app.js','public/index.html','public/privacy.html','scripts/build-html.mjs','vercel.json'].filter(f=>!fs.existsSync(f));if(m.length){console.error('
Some files or folders are missing from your GitHub repository (missing: '+m.join(', ')+').
Upload the folders api, lib, public and scripts themselves (not only the files inside them), plus package.json, package-lock.json and vercel.json, all at the top level of the repository. See README, step 1.
');process.exit(1)}"
